plan.selection: 40 randomly sampled rows per true class; same frozen 120 rows for all models; no labels sent to Qwen
plan.scope: General text sentiment, not the company-specific production news-review task, and not trading returns. Unknown pretraining overlap.

limitations: Balanced sample is not natural class prevalence.
120 examples are a diagnostic, not comprehensive validation.
Current foundation-model pretraining may contain these historical public texts.
This prompt measures general sentiment; production Qwen additionally filters company relevance and ambiguity.
Sentiment accuracy does not establish trading profitability.
